title: Small snake, strong venom
literal_meaning: A small snake’s venom is strong.
meaning_odia: ଢଗଟି ଛୋଟ ସାପ ସହିତ ଟାଣ ବିଷର ଚିତ୍ର ଯୋଡ଼ୁଛି। ଆମ ପଢ଼ାରେ, ଆକାର ଛୋଟ ବୋଲି କାହାର କିମ୍ବା କୌଣସି ଜିନିଷର କ୍ଷତି କରିବାର ଶକ୍ତିକୁ ତୁଚ୍ଛ ଭାବିବା ଉଚିତ ନୁହେଁ। ଏହା ଢଗର ରୂପକ; ସାପର ଆକାର ଓ ବିଷ ବିଷୟରେ ଜୀବବିଜ୍ଞାନର ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ।
explanation: The line puts small size beside strong venom. Our editorial reading is a warning against dismissing a threat because it looks small. The venom claim belongs to the proverb’s imagery; it is not a biological rule about snakes.
usage_example: Original imagined example: A team dismisses a tiny error in a calculation, but it changes every total that follows. A colleague recalls the small snake and its strong venom to challenge that dismissal.
cultural_context: The force comes from the contrast between ଛୋଟ and ଟାଣ: small in visible size, strong in effect. The short sentence leaves the listener to carry that contrast into another situation.
